newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT SLUMPS VS DOLLAR, STEADY VS BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT SLUMPS VS DOLLAR, STEADY VS BASKET.

text.p: The soaring dollar showed no mercy for the Hungarian forint which plummeted against the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The Hungarian currency closed at 196.10/15 to the dollar, more than a forint below its opening level of 195.05/10.
The forint was steady against the central bank's currency basket and closed the session at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level, forex traders said.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
